limitations: 描述当前1980—2024合格非中立档案中的比赛平均主胜率，不代表国家等权或全球无偏样本。
调整只统一年代×赛事构成，未控制具体主客队实力；不是地理的因果作用或纯主场优势。
地域表示球队归属，不是实际旅行距离；历史球队使用已明示的固定载体，未知保留。
不同目标参考不同，不能把跨目标数值拼为全球排名；欧洲内部四组才共享其欧洲参考。
欧洲六个成对差值只有三个独立方向；相关比赛、共同时间冲击、多比较与区间留第四问。
南美地域关系末期跨大区无比赛，全时期调整差不可计算；不删年、不填补。
统计可靠性、分类敏感性和实力调整未运行；独立核算不等于组员已复现或事实全部验证。
研究标签以M49为底表，但伊朗归西亚、澳大利亚归亚洲/东南亚、土耳其归欧洲/南欧为事先指定的项目规则；不是完整足联分类。
条件矩阵区分主队和客队，反向赛程不互补；正参考层缺赛程时调整率留空，不能用0补齐。

architecture.document: 研究/05_赛前实力/实力评估算法_初步架构与数学依据.md
architecture.predictor: Gaussian latent performance difference + venue term + symmetric draw threshold; integrate joint rating uncertainty
architecture.uncertainty: pre-match Gaussian plus compound Poisson; within-day full covariance; modular shape/residual parameter uncertainty
architecture.correction: Optional outcome mixture with kappa_C=1-epsilon and kappa_F=alpha*(1-epsilon), background uniform as testable starting assumption
architecture.same_date: implemented pre-day predictions followed by joint damped EP
architecture.bilateral_updates: One match contributes once to both teams; common base strength across home/away; no team-specific away coefficient in first model
architecture.persistent_transition: Zero-drift diffusion + compound-Poisson Gaussian level increments; symmetric rises/falls, calendar-time prior
architecture.change_paths: prior counts integrated before outcomes; Gaussian projection after day, no exact discrete-history attribution
architecture.history_period_interface: Adaptive information memory; fixed-window/exponential policies reserved for Q6;1/lambda is not optimal lookback
architecture.change_detection_validation: False alarms/delay/amplitude require known-truth simulations including misspecification; real outcomes alone do not label true strength shifts
architecture.branch_meaning: old enumerated branch models retained as failed history; current collapsed-factor model adopted
